title.ja: 分野ごとの実装・検証範囲

policy.ja: 項目数の拡大より、既存モデルの解説・専用コード・固定入力・参照比較・収束確認を揃えることを優先します。分野の代表例と未実装の範囲を示し、完成率や一律の認証は付けません。
policy.en: Prioritize complete paths through reading, dedicated code, fixed inputs, reference comparisons and refinement for existing models over adding entries. Show representative evidence and remaining gaps, without completion percentages or blanket certification.

scope.ja: Euler衝撃波・滑らかな渦などに複数の教育用コードと保存結果があります。固定入力での検証内容は問題ごとに異なります。
scope.en: Several educational codes and saved results cover Euler shocks and smooth vortices. Fixed-input validation differs by problem.

reference.ja: Sodは厳密Riemann解。Shu–Osherは独立実装Athena++の保存参照と比較。細格子差と独立参照差を区別。
reference.en: Sod uses the exact Riemann solution. Shu–Osher compares with a stored independent Athena++ reference. Separate fine-grid differences from independent-reference differences.

refinement.ja: 各実行例の格子誤差・保存則・減衰などを確認。全流体問題の一括認証ではありません。
refinement.en: Checks include grid errors, conservation and decay in individual examples; this is not blanket fluid-solver certification.

next.ja: 同じ問題で手法間の誤差・散逸・失敗条件を比較する。
next.en: Compare error, dissipation and failure conditions across methods on the same problem.

scope.ja: 既存Brio–Wuに加え、Brio–WuとOrszag–Tangの独立Athena++参照照合、同じ連続初期場・終了時刻・CFLでのCT／採用GLM比較を追加。GLM Fourier例はdiv B制約診断で、物理問題数に重複加算しません。
scope.en: In addition to the shared Brio–Wu example, compare Brio–Wu and Orszag–Tang with independent Athena++ references and CT/adopted GLM at the same continuous initial field, final time and CFL. The GLM Fourier case is a divergence-constraint diagnostic, not an additional physical problem.

reference.ja: 保存済みAthena++参照は別実装。GLM Fourier振幅は解析解。同一条件比較でもCT／GLMのdiv Bのnative演算子と実ステップ数は異なります。
reference.en: Stored Athena++ results are from an independent implementation; GLM Fourier amplitudes have an analytic reference. CT/GLM use different native div B operators and actual step counts even in the stated matched comparison.

refinement.ja: 固定格子系列の誤差・保存量・正値性を確認。採用GLMはch=3、κ=0.18 ch nの格子依存減衰です。一般のGLMや発散尺度の同一性を保証しません。
refinement.en: Check errors, conservation and positivity over fixed grids. The adopted GLM has ch=3 and grid-dependent damping κ=0.18 ch n. This does not certify general GLM variants or equivalence of divergence measures.

next.ja: より高分解能・長時間、別の発散診断、別変種は独立に検証する。
next.en: Validate higher resolutions, longer runs, other divergence diagnostics and other variants separately.

scope.ja: Poisson・Bratu・粒子重力に固定入力例があります。
scope.en: Poisson, Bratu and particle-gravity fixed-input examples.

reference.ja: 製造解、直接和、離散残差など、問題ごとの参照。参照の種類は実行ページに明記。
reference.en: Problem-specific manufactured solutions, direct sums and discrete residuals, identified in each entry.

refinement.ja: 格子・近似パラメータの収束と残差を個別に確認。
refinement.en: Individual checks of grid/approximation refinement and residuals.

next.ja: 境界条件と離散化をそろえ、残差と解誤差を比較する。
next.en: Match boundary conditions and discretizations when comparing residual and solution errors.

scope.ja: 水素型原子と球対称1 s² Heの閉殻HF・交換のみLDAに限定した2問題群です。
scope.en: Two problem families: hydrogenic atoms and spherical 1 s² helium with closed-shell HF / exchange-only LDA.

reference.ja: Hは解析解、Heは別実装PySCF/Libxc参照。有限基底・格子値・外挿推定は区別。
reference.en: Analytic hydrogen states and separate PySCF/Libxc helium references; finite-basis, grid and extrapolated values remain distinct.

refinement.ja: 半径格子の収束・SCF残差・終了条件を保存。相関エネルギーの厳密値を再現する計算ではありません。
refinement.en: Stored radial-grid convergence, SCF residuals and termination; not an exact correlated-energy calculation.

next.ja: 原子の検証を保持し、別配布のH₂分子RHFとの数値表現の違いを比較する。
next.en: Preserve atomic validation and compare its numerical representation with the separately packaged H₂ RHF example.

name.en: Quantum: H₂ HF and molecular DFT

scope.ja: 新しいH₂の閉殻RHF例：自作s型Gaussian積分、独立PySCF比較、SCF残差・基底拡大を確認。有限のs型部分空間に限定し、一般分子・分子DFT・周期系・正しい解離極限は検証しません。 別欄の固定He周期LDAは限定した例外として実行可能。
scope.en: New H₂ closed-shell RHF example: original s-Gaussian integrals, independent PySCF comparisons, SCF residuals and basis refinement. Limited to finite s-type subspaces; does not validate general molecules, molecular DFT, periodic systems or correct dissociation. The separate fixed-He periodic-LDA field supplies one scoped runnable exception.

reference.ja: H₂の同一有限基底・同一核間距離で独立PySCFと比較。自作コードの積分はPySCFから取得しない。
reference.en: Independent PySCF at identical finite bases and separations. Educational integrals are not obtained from PySCF.

refinement.ja: SCFの密度・エネルギー・交換子残差と、入れ子s型基底の隣接エネルギー差を別に評価。最終差と指定公差の成否を示す。角運動量・完全基底極限は未確認。
refinement.en: Separate SCF density/energy/commutator checks from adjacent nested-s-basis energy changes. Report the final change and tolerance outcome. Angular/complete-basis convergence is not established.

next.ja: 分極関数を含むH₂の基底比較、一般分子DFT・FCIは今後の課題。周期Heの限定例は別欄に掲載。
next.en: Polarized H₂ basis comparisons, general molecular DFT and FCI remain future work. The scoped periodic-He example has a separate field.

scope.ja: 22モデル族の文献解説に、既存のロジスティック増殖・閉鎖SIRと、新しい線形反応拡散Fourierモード・SchnakenbergのTuring発現・FitzHugh–Nagumo励起回復の小さな専用例を接続。全22モデルやHodgkin–Huxleyの実装を意味しません。
scope.en: The 22-family survey links the existing logistic-growth/closed-SIR examples and small new examples of a linear reaction–diffusion Fourier mode, Schnakenberg Turing onset and FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation/recovery. This does not implement all 22 families or Hodgkin–Huxley.

reference.ja: ロジスティックと線形反応拡散は解析解。SIR・FHNは別実装DOP853。Turing線形段階は2×2 Fourier行列の指数関数。
reference.en: Analytic logistic and linear reaction–diffusion solutions; independent DOP853 for SIR/FHN; a 2×2 Fourier matrix exponential for the linear Turing stage.

refinement.ja: ODEの時間収束に加え、反応拡散の空間2次・時間4次とTuring初期成長を分離。短い非線形Schnakenberg計算の有界性を測定。
refinement.en: In addition to ODE time refinement, separate second-order spatial and fourth-order temporal refinement for reaction–diffusion and initial Turing growth. Check boundedness only for the short nonlinear Schnakenberg run.

next.ja: SEIR・完全HH・成熟した非線形模様・実測較正は未実装または未検証。反応拡散の一般生物モデルへ結果を外挿しない。
next.en: SEIR, full HH, mature nonlinear patterns and observational calibration remain unimplemented or unvalidated. Do not extrapolate to general biological reaction–diffusion models.

scope.ja: 既存IID x²積分・スカラーItô幾何Brown運動に、1次元Gaussian標的のMetropolis–Hastings MCMCを追加。確率計算法全般の完成を意味しません。
scope.en: Add Metropolis–Hastings MCMC for a 1D Gaussian target to the existing IID x² integration and scalar Itô geometric Brownian motion. These do not complete stochastic computation.

reference.ja: 解析積分・分散・共有Brown経路上のGBM解析解。MCMCはGaussianの既知モーメントとCDF、自己相関診断は既知AR(1)と比較。
reference.en: Analytic integral/variance and GBM on common Brownian paths. Compare MCMC with known Gaussian moments/CDF and autocorrelation diagnostics with known AR(1).

refinement.ja: 既存MCの256 seed・GBMの4096経路に加え、MCMCの32独立連鎖、正値系列自己相関時間・ESS・古典的split R-hatを確認。固定seed・予算での統計的判定であり、全seedや全標的での保証ではありません。
refinement.en: In addition to the existing 256-seed MC and 4096-path GBM runs, check 32 independent MCMC chains, positive-sequence autocorrelation time/ESS and classical split R-hat. Statistical acceptance is specific to the fixed seeds/budgets, not every seed or target.

next.ja: 多峰性・高次元標的、希少事象、一般SDEや診断の普遍性は未検証。
next.en: Multimodal/high-dimensional targets, rare events, general SDEs and universal diagnostic reliability remain unvalidated.

scope.ja: 12手法を比較解説。LangevinのBAOABによる1次元調和振動子NVTだけに専用コード・固定入力・分布検証を追加。他の11手法は実装予定です。
scope.en: Comparative reading covers 12 methods. Dedicated code, fixed inputs and distribution checks cover only a 1D harmonic-oscillator NVT example with Langevin BAOAB. The other 11 methods remain planned.

reference.ja: 連続の線形Gaussian伝播の行列指数関数と、独立な離散Lyapunov方程式による定常共分散。正準位置・運動量・全エネルギーCDFと照合。
reference.en: A continuous linear-Gaussian matrix-exponential propagator and an independent discrete-Lyapunov stationary covariance. Compare canonical position, momentum and total-energy CDFs.

refinement.ja: dt=0.4/0.2/0.1、32768独立レプリカ。位置・運動量共分散の刻み依存、時差相関、有限burn-inの残差を分離。固定seedでの分布判定。
refinement.en: dt=0.4/0.2/0.1 with 32768 independent replicas. Separate covariance step bias, lagged correlations and finite-burn-in residuals. Distribution acceptance is for fixed seeds.

next.ja: 非調和・多粒子系、結合時間の広い走査、Nosé–Hoover・CSVRなど他11手法の専用検証は未実装。
next.en: Anharmonic/many-particle systems, broad coupling-time sweeps and dedicated checks for the other 11 methods, including Nosé–Hoover/CSVR, remain unimplemented.

name.ja: 周期DFT：静的Heと多原子の力
name.en: Periodic DFT: static He and multiatom forces

scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals. Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

reference.ja: DFTKの別実装・平面波基底と同じ幾何・GTH係数・Libxc汎関数で比較。Gaussianと平面波の有限基底差を含むため、各収束差を併記する。
reference.en: Compare independent DFTK plane waves at identical geometry, GTH coefficients and Libxc functionals. State each convergence difference because finite Gaussian/plane-wave basis differences remain.

refinement.ja: 全エネルギーと力を区別し、k点・Gaussian基底・FFT補助格子・SCF、変位幅、独立平面波カットオフの各系列を保存。
refinement.en: Distinguish total-energy and force convergence. Save k-point, Gaussian-basis, FFT-grid, SCF, displacement-step and independent plane-wave-cutoff sequences.

next.ja: BOMDの長時間NVE保存量と刻み幅・SCF公差への感度を検証し、他物質・非局所擬ポテンシャル・金属は別に検証する。
next.en: Validate long BOMD NVE conservation and timestep/SCF sensitivity. Other materials, nonlocal pseudopotentials and metals need separate evidence.

scope.ja: SA-AMG、Householder QR・one-sided Jacobi SVD、再直交化Krylov固有値、Gauss・適応求積の小規模固定例。
scope.en: Small fixed-input examples of SA-AMG, Householder QR/one-sided Jacobi SVD, reorthogonalized Krylov eigenvalues and Gauss/adaptive quadrature.

reference.ja: Poissonの解析解・独立疎直接解、NumPy/SciPyの独立分解・固有値、解析積分。
reference.en: Analytic Poisson/independent sparse direct solve, independent NumPy/SciPy factorizations/eigenvalues and analytic integrals.

refinement.ja: 残差と解誤差、直交性と再構成、固有残差と真値の距離、求積誤差を別々に測定。
refinement.en: Measure residual/solution errors, orthogonality/reconstruction, eigen-residual/reference distance and quadrature errors separately.

next.ja: 小さな教育用実装。大規模並列AMG、任意の非対称・悪条件行列、全求積問題の保証はない。
next.en: Small educational implementations; no certification of large parallel AMG, arbitrary nonsymmetric/ill-conditioned matrices or all integrands.

name.ja: 粒子・静電場・気体運動論

scope.ja: 中性周期電荷のEwald／B-spline SPME、2次元自由空間対数核の真のFMM、1次元cold-plasma PIC、均質Maxwell分子のDSMC衝突成分を小規模検証。
scope.en: Small validations of neutral-periodic Ewald/B-spline SPME, a genuine 2D free-space logarithmic FMM, 1D cold-plasma PIC and a homogeneous Maxwell-molecule DSMC collision component.

reference.ja: Ewaldの別級数・直接和、SPMEと収束Ewald、FMMの直接粒子和、PICの線形振動、DSMCの保存量・分布診断を区別。
reference.en: Distinguish alternate Ewald series/direct sums, SPME against converged Ewald, FMM direct particle sums, PIC linear oscillation and DSMC conservation/distribution diagnostics.

refinement.ja: 打切り・メッシュ・多重極次数・PIC刻みを各例で確認。SPMEは1993年のLagrange補間PMEそのものではない。DSMCの衝突round数は物理時間と解釈しない。
refinement.en: Check case-specific cutoffs, meshes, multipole order and PIC step refinement. SPME is not the original 1993 Lagrange-interpolation PME. DSMC collision rounds are not interpreted as physical time.

next.ja: 一般3D Coulomb FMM、複雑なプラズマ、空間輸送を含む物理時間DSMC、実在気体は未検証。
next.en: General 3D Coulomb FMM, complex plasmas, physical-time DSMC with spatial transport and real gases remain unvalidated.

scope.ja: 吸収のみの1次元平板で角度離散化と風上空間離散化を実装。散乱や多周波輸送へ広げない。
scope.en: Implement angular quadrature and upwind spatial discretization in an absorbing 1D slab; excludes scattering and multifrequency transport.

reference.ja: 厳密ray解、連続角度の指数積分によるfluxを独立参照に使う。
reference.en: Exact-ray solutions and continuum-angle exponential-integral flux provide independent references.

refinement.ja: 厳密rayでの純角度誤差と、同じ角度求積に対する空間誤差を分離。
refinement.en: Separate pure angular error using exact rays from spatial error at a fixed angular quadrature.

next.ja: 散乱、時間依存、多次元・不透明度結合は別の検証が必要。
next.en: Scattering, time dependence, multiple dimensions and opacity coupling require separate validation.
